Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that the main cast member introduced in Season 2 (Danny DeVito) has 5 Emmy Award nominations as of August 3, 2024. The Predicted Answer claims Danny DeVito has six Emmy Award nominations as of the same date. While the Predicted Answer correctly identifies the relevant cast member and the context, it provides a different number of Emmy nominations than the Ground Truth. Therefore, the substance and vital fact (the number of nominations) do NOT match.
